strategy_overhaul_plan: 1. Liquidity focus: limit entries to stocks with average daily volume > 5M shares and bid‑ask spread < 0.5%. 2. Entry timing: use a 15‑minute moving average of price and volume to confirm momentum; require m15 > 0.5% and rvol > 1.5 before a long. 3. ATR‑based stops: set initial stop at 1.5× ATR(14) below entry for longs, 1.5× ATR(14) above entry for shorts, ensuring stop distance scales with volatility. 4. 50‑day MA filter: only trade if price is above the 50‑day MA; if below, restrict to defensive mean‑reversion setups. 5. Position sizing: cap each trade at 15% of equity, maintain at most 5 open positions, 15 trades/day. 6. Risk management: enforce 1–2% stop‑loss, 2–4% first target, trailing stop at 1% after first target. 7. Execution: use limit orders at VWAP or 0.2% above/below for breakouts, avoid market orders to reduce slippage. 8. Review: after 5 trading days, evaluate win rate and P&L; adjust ATR multiplier or volume threshold if needed.
